attchmntText: Man Industries (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Man Industries India Limited filed an earnings presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated total income for Q2 FY27 was 1,216 crore rupees, up 49.3 percent year-on-year. Half-year consolidated total income reached 2,281 crore rupees, a 43.6 percent increase. Consolidated EBITDA for Q2 FY27 stood at 190 crore rupees, while half-year EBITDA was 345 crore rupees. Consolidated PAT for Q2 FY27 was 82 crore rupees, and half-year PAT was 143 crore rupees. The company reported a consolidated order book of approximately 3,500 crore rupees. Strategic updates include a new HSAW pipe manufacturing facility in the USA with 350,000 metric tons per annum capacity and 110 million US dollars planned capex. The Dammam coating plant in Saudi Arabia is targeted for March 2027, and the Jammu greenfield stainless steel plant for April 2027. A joint development agreement for Merino Shelters was launched on October 26, 2026.

attchmntText: Man Industries (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a revised press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Revised Press Release / Media Release for the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.".
voiceSummary: Man Industries India Limited filed a revised press release regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated EBITDA reached 190 crore, up 86.6% year-on-year, with consolidated PAT growing 121.7% to 82 crore. Consolidated revenue from operations rose 49.3% to 1,216 crore. The company reported a consolidated order book of approximately 3,500 crore. Revenue of approximately 320 crore was deferred due to shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz. The acquisition of National Pipe Company contributed significantly to performance. The company announced progress on the Merino Shelters joint development agreement, expected cash flows of 700 to 800 crore over five to six years, and production timelines for the Jammu greenfield plant by April 2027. Operations at the Dammam facility are targeted for March 2027. A new HSAW pipe facility in the USA with a capacity of 350,000 MTPA and planned capex of US$110 million was also disclosed.

desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Man Industries India Limited filed a statement of deviation or variation for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company confirms there is no deviation or variation in the utilization of funds raised through the preferential issue of 1219512 convertible warrants to promoters and 7774383 equity shares to non-promoters. Funds raised via warrants amount to Rs. 999,99,984 on August 2, 2025. Funds raised via equity shares amount to Rs. 254,99,97,624 on July 28, 2025. Monitoring agency CRISIL Ratings Limited is applicable for the equity share issue. No deviation exists in the use of funds for meeting working capital requirements, expansion of existing business, or general corporate purpose. The report was signed by Chief Financial Officer Sandeep Kumar on November 12, 2026.

attchmntText: Man Industries (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Press Release / Media Release for the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.".
voiceSummary: Man Industries India Limited filed press release for unaudited financial results for quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated EBITDA reached 190 crore, up 86.6 percent year on year. Consolidated revenue from operations grew 49.3 percent to 1,216 crore. Consolidated PAT rose 121.7 percent to 82 crore. Standalone revenue from operations was 721 crore. Standalone EBITDA was 96 crore. Standalone PAT was 40 crore. Revenue of approximately 320 crore was deferred due to shipping disruptions. Consolidated order book stands at approximately 3,500 crore. The company acquired National Pipe Company on 21 May 2026. Production at Jammu greenfield plant is expected by April 2027. Dammam facility operations are targeted for March 2027. A US facility with capacity of 350,000 MTPA and capex of US dollar 110 million is planned.

attchmntText: Man Industries (India) Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Man Industries India Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board also approved the establishment of a manufacturing facility in the United States of America for HSAW Pipes. This project will be executed through a wholly owned subsidiary. The estimated capacity is 3,50,000 MTPA. The estimated project cost is approximately USD 110 million. The facility aims to cater to demand in the USA and international markets. The business falls within the company's main line of operations. The transaction is not a related party transaction. Consideration will be in cash. The company will seek applicable governmental and regulatory approvals in the United States. The timeline for completion depends on fulfilling statutory requirements. The financial results are available on the company website. The board meeting was held on November 12, 2026.
